root = Path.cwd()
def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for p in root.rglob('*'):
        s = p.lstat()
        rel = str(p.relative_to(root))
        if p.is_symlink():
            result[rel] = ('link', stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), os.readlink(p))
        elif p.is_file():
            result[rel] = ('file', stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), p.read_bytes())
        else:
            result[rel] = ('dir', stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode))
    return result
before = snapshot()
source = (root / 'build_plan.py').read_text()
variants = {
    'correct': source,
    'reverse': source.replace('    return order\\n', '    return order[::-1]\\n'),
    'clear_inputs': source.replace('    ready =', '    for parents in dependencies.values():\\n        parents.clear()\\n    ready =', 1),

from build_plan import plan

class StrongTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_chain_order(self):
        graph = {\"ship\": [\"compile\"], \"compile\": [\"fetch\"], \"fetch\": []}
        result = plan(graph)
        self.assertEqual(result, [\"fetch\", \"compile\", \"ship\"])

    def test_input_preserved_success(self):
        graph = {\"ship\": [\"compile\"], \"compile\": [\"fetch\"], \"fetch\": []}
        before = {name: parents[:] for name, parents in graph.items()}
        aliases = dict(graph)
        result = plan(graph)
        self.assertEqual(result, [\"fetch\", \"compile\", \"ship\"])
        self.assertEqual(graph, before)
        for name in before:
            self.assertIs(graph[name], aliases[name])
            self.assertEqual(aliases[name], before[name])

    def test_input_preserved_cycle(self):
        graph = {\"a\": [\"b\"], \"b\": [\"a\"]}
        before = {name: parents[:] for name, parents in graph.items()}
        aliases = dict(graph)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, \""'^dependency cycle$"):
            plan(graph)
        self.assertEqual(graph, before)
        for name in before:
            self.assertIs(graph[name], aliases[name])
            self.assertEqual(aliases[name], before[name])
'"'''
